account_identity: Exact account_order and labels, complete account population, isolated accounts retained.
evaluation: Static full-observation transductive account classification. No transaction-label graph sampling.
selection: unweighted mean of three inner-fold AP values
development_threshold_split: reuse old inner_fit and inner_calibration, 80/20 of outer_train
threshold_selection: max positive-class F1 on independent threshold_validation; ties lowest threshold
rounds_or_epochs: integer median across selected three inner fits
class_weighting: balanced from actual fitting labels; XGB sample_weight; eval unweighted
gnn_weighting: Global balanced weights computed from fit labels; seed-only BCE, minibatch mean weighted loss.
gnn_preprocessing: Nonnegative BASE magnitude log1p, then standardization; fit scaler on current fit subset only. Identity and labels are never model inputs.
alarm_ties: score descending then source account row ascending; same k rounding as existing supplementary code
inference_primary: mean paired increments, sample SD(ddof=1), positive folds and complete seed OOF consistency
optional_p_values: Approximate corrected-CV/Holm sensitivity only; freeze new families and acknowledge residual graph dependence; do not convert to independent confirmation.

geometry.sampling: path-preserving shared BFS prefix; lexicographic ID within layer
geometry.H0: same exact original six encoded columns, not independent PH shape

gfp.method: official Snap ML GFP with documented account adaptation
gfp.input: float64 [unique transaction_id, source_id, target_id, seconds_timestamp, amount_paid, amount_received]
gfp.undefined_engineered_statistics: nonfinite native engineered values -> 0, count by column; never drop accounts or impute indexing fields
gfp.time_ties: timestamp group; stable original_row_id order; explicit partial_fit(group) then query same IDs only after native duplicate-ID and tie-batch tests pass
gfp.not_equivalent: Native temporal directed multigraph GFP vs static simple-graph FlowTopo; report this input-view difference.

existing_graph32_state: remains paused_by_user; no old partial setting is promoted to complete.
new_runners: not implemented by this design generator; implementation and resource gates precede any training.
